title: Black Friday 2026 UK live deals: the best offers right now
seoTitle: Black Friday 2026 UK: Best Live Deals (Updated Today)
description: The best genuine UK Black Friday 2026 deals live right now, checked three times a day. Tech, home, beauty and toys, with prices compared.
intro:
**Last checked: Thursday 19 November, 5:53pm.** The three standouts right now: the **Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition at £139.99** (still its record low), **Apple AirPods Pro 3 at £174**, their lowest price yet, and the **Garmin fēnix 8 at £484.99**, well under its recent low. All three are at Amazon.

Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until 30 November. We check this page three times a day and remove anything that has sold out or gone back up. This evening we added the AirPods Pro 3 (£174) and Lego Icons Star Trek U.S.S. Enterprise (£297.49), both at Amazon. We took off the Ninja StaySharp knife block and the standard Fire TV Stick 4K because we couldn't re-check their prices this evening. Prices were reported on 18 and 19 November, so check the price on the retailer's page before you buy.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: Wireless charging, an auto-adjusting light and 32GB of storage. £139.99 is the lowest price it has been. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
deals.note: £45 under Apple's price and below the £175 to £183 they reached earlier this year. The AirPods to buy this Black Friday.

deals.name: Garmin fēnix 8 (47mm)
deals.note: Garmin's top multisport watch with maps and a torch, still £484.99 on 19 November. Which?'s six-month low on Amazon was about £553, so this is well below anything seen recently. Check the case size and screen type on the listing.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L Air Fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: The two-drawer Ninja most families buy. It was £125 to £128 last Black Friday, so this already beats it. More in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra (2025)
deals.note: Samsung's toughest smartwatch with a titanium case and multi-day battery, £250 off at Amazon (listed 19 November). Best with an Android phone; iPhone owners should look at Apple Watch instead.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max (latest model)
deals.note: The fastest Fire TV Stick, with Wi-Fi 6E and ambient mode, at more than half off on the first day of Amazon's Black Friday Week. Worth the extra £15 over the 4K if you stream a lot.

deals.name: Dyson V8 Origin Cordless Vacuum
deals.note: Dyson's lightest-on-the-wallet cordless at £130 off, listed in Amazon's early Black Friday deals on 18 November. Fine for flats and quick tidy-ups. More in our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Ember 50-inch 4K TV
deals.note: Amazon's own 4K TV with Fire TV built in, at its lowest price yet. A sensible bedroom or second-room TV. More in our [TV Black Friday guide](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Oura Ring 5
deals.note: A sleep and recovery tracker you wear as a ring, £100 off at Amazon (listed 19 November). Remember the app needs a monthly membership after the first month, so factor that in.

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: A wire-free doorbell plus a plug-in indoor camera for about what the doorbell alone usually costs. The 'was' price adds the two list prices together, but £40 for both is still excellent.

deals.name: Blink Outdoor 4 Camera + Blink Video Doorbell bundle
deals.note: A wire-free outdoor camera and a video doorbell for £25, the cheapest way to cover your front door this Black Friday. The 'was' price adds two list prices together, but it's still a standout. See our [Ring doorbell guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum gift set
deals.note: The Perfume Shop lists it at £56.24 after its 25% off, a saving of £44.76. One of the best-selling women's gift sets; check the bottle size on the listing. See our [perfume gift sets guide](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (2024, 16GB)
deals.note: The basic Kindle with a glare-free screen and adjustable light, £30 off and a record low (reported 18 November). The Paperwhite above is worth the extra £20 for its bigger, waterproof screen. See our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Portable Glass Air Fryer
deals.note: Cooks in glass dishes you can serve from and store leftovers in. Under last year's Black Friday price of £117. Good for one or two people.

deals.name: De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next Bean-to-Cup Coffee Machine
deals.note: Grinds beans fresh and froths milk at a touch. Compare it with the alternatives in our [coffee machine Black Friday guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Nothing Ear (3a) Wireless Earbuds
deals.note: Noise-cancelling earbuds with a clear, punchy sound for £40 off. A cheaper alternative to AirPods; see our [AirPods Black Friday guide](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/) for Apple prices.

deals.name: Sonos Move 2 Portable Speaker
deals.note: A big-sounding battery speaker that works on Wi-Fi at home and Bluetooth in the garden. £90 off at Amazon, still live on 19 November.

deals.name: Philips Hue Festavia Smart String Lights (20m)
deals.note: App-controlled Christmas tree lights with gradient effects, 30% off at Amazon this morning (19 November), with an extra voucher on some listings. Festavia usually sells for £149 to £264 depending on length. Needs a Hue Bridge for the full feature set.

deals.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop (13.8-inch, Snapdragon X2 Plus, 16GB, 512GB)
deals.note: A thin, long-lasting Windows laptop with £550 off. Check the exact spec on the listing, as Amazon sells several versions.

deals.name: Revlon Salon One-Step Hair Dryer and Volumiser
deals.note: Dries and adds volume in one go with a round brush head. £24.99 at Amazon (Currys is £25) is a record low and a good stocking filler. More haircare in our [ghd Black Friday guide](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi Soft Serve
deals.note: Soft-serve and scoopable ice cream in one machine, £60 off at Amazon (still £289 on 19 November). Creami prices often dip again in Black Friday Week. See our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Star Wars Advent Calendar 2026
deals.note: It needs to arrive by 1 December, so there's no point waiting. Every set is in our [Lego advent calendar 2026 guide](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/).

deals.name: LEGO Harry Potter Hogsmeade Village Collectors' Edition
deals.note: A 3,228-piece display set with 12 minifigures, £90 off at Argos (reported 18 November). [Check Amazon's price](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=LEGO+Hogsmeade+Village+Collectors+Edition) too, as it often matches. More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Lego Icons Star Trek U.S.S. Enterprise NCC-1701-D
deals.note: 15% off in Amazon's Black Friday Week. A big display set for Star Trek fans; fair rather than a record low.

deals.name: LEGO Icons The Lord of the Rings: Rivendell (10316)
deals.note: The huge 6,000-plus-piece Rivendell display set at 18% off on Amazon (listed 19 November). A big one-off gift for adult Lego fans. More in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

body:
## Tech

The best tech deals right now are on Amazon's own devices: the Kindle Paperwhite Signature, the Ring doorbell bundle, the £24.99 Blink Outdoor 4 and doorbell bundle and the Fire TV Stick 4K Max at £46.99. The standard Kindle is £119.99 too. The Garmin fēnix 8 at £484.99 is the standout watch deal. Echo speakers are only modestly cut so far (the Echo Spot is £54.99), so they may drop further this week. For laptops, the Surface Laptop at £899 is the biggest cut we've seen. Amazon's own Ember 50-inch 4K TV is at its lowest price yet at £269.99. For wearables, the Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra is £349 (£250 off) and the Oura Ring 5 is £399. For audio, the AirPods Pro 3 are at a record-low £174, Nothing Ear (3a) earbuds are £59 and the Sonos Move 2 portable speaker is £359. We've dropped the Beats deals until we can confirm they're still live.

More: [Kindle](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ring doorbells](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/), [AirPods](/guides/airpods-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Amazon Black Friday 2026](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

## Home & kitchen

Ninja's air fryers are already at or below last year's Black Friday prices, so there's little reason to wait. Coffee machines are well discounted too (the De'Longhi Magnifica Evo Next is £379.99 at Amazon), the Dyson V8 Origin at £199.99 (Amazon) is the standout vacuum deal, and Philips Hue Festavia smart Christmas lights are 30% off at £119.99. The Dyson V15 Detect Absolute deals have ended (it's back to about £649), so we've removed it; see our [Dyson V15 guide](/guides/dyson-v15-deals-uk/) for the price to wait for.

More: [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [coffee machines](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Beauty

The Revlon One-Step volumiser is at a record-low £24.99 at Amazon, and ghd has cut the Duet Style hot air styler to £259 (£120 off) on its own site. Perfume gift sets are now properly discounted: The Perfume Shop has Lancôme La Vie Est Belle at £56.24, and Superdrug's Black Friday fragrance event runs until 1 December. Amazon sells most of the same sets, so [compare Amazon's perfume gift set prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=perfume+gift+set) before you buy.

More: [perfume gift sets](/guides/perfume-gift-sets-black-friday-2026/), [ghd](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Oral-B](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## Toys & gifts

Advent calendars need to arrive by 1 December, so buy those now. For bigger Lego gifts, Argos has Hogsmeade Village down to £260, and Amazon has Rivendell at £350 and the Star Trek U.S.S. Enterprise at £297.49. For toys, Hamleys is running its own Black Friday event, and our guide shows what's worth buying there. Switch 2 bundles are worth checking again as Amazon's sale goes on.

More: [Hamleys Black Friday 2026](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego advent calendars](/guides/lego-advent-calendar-2026/) and [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/).

## How we pick these deals

Every price comes from the retailer or a trusted deals source dated today or yesterday. We compare it with price history and last year's Black Friday prices, and we leave out deals where the 'was' price is inflated. When Amazon matches the cheapest shop, we link Amazon. Many Amazon prices need Prime during Black Friday Week; our [Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how to time a trial.

### When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's dates.

### Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

If a deal here is marked 'Lowest price', it's already at or below last year's Black Friday price, so buy it. Items marked 'Good price' could still fall a little in the final week.

### How often is this page updated?

Three times a day, every day until Cyber Monday. Deals that end or go up in price are removed.

See [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for brand-by-brand prices to wait for.
